records.text: Sarah Huckabee Sanders announced that Arkansas was launching Club America and would encourage students across the country to join.
records.speaker: Sarah Huckabee Sanders

appearances.snippet: We're so proud to have her and we're so proud of the incredible work that she is doing to help encourage students across the country to engage and join Club America, which we're launching here in Arkansas.

verification.notes: Arkansas Governor Sarah Huckabee Sanders and Erika Kirk announced a statewide partnership to bring Club America chapters to Arkansas high schools. Sanders' quoted remarks also praised the effort to engage students, matching the announcement in context.

sources.title: Governor Sanders and Turning Point USA's Erika Kirk Announce a Statewide Club America Partnership
sources.relevance: Official Arkansas governor release confirming the statewide Club America launch.
